And it schal ȝeue plenteuously heelþe: and so it is preued by astronomy aboue, þat sterris þat haþ influence vpon̅ þe heed and þe necke of man / as ben þe sterris of aries, taurus, and gemini, ȝeuen influence syngulerly vpon̅ Gerapigra galieni /

And þerfore it haþ a synguler strenkþe, by þe ordynaunce of god, to drawe awey þe superflue humouris fro þe heed, þe necke, and þe brest, and not fro þe membris byneþe / And so I seie of spicis þat drawiþ humouris fro þe knees, þe leggis, and þe feet, þat resseyuen a synguler influence of þe sterris of Capricorn, Aquarie and pisces, & riȝt so of oþere, et cetera /
